art.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW six-panel comic illustration in a STRICT 3 columns by 2 rows grid, equal square panels, landscape 1536x1024, thin black gutters exactly at one-third and two-thirds width and halfway height. NO letters, labels, captions, speech bubbles, typography, logos or watermarks anywhere. Original expressive manga Sunday-comic drawing, rich warm wooden workshop, ink outlines, luminous painted shading, same quality and identities as the reference illustrations. Every panel has different framing, strong readable action, upright heads except action, varying front/profile/three-quarter views. Hugo adult short brown hair, trimmed beard, bright blue-green eyes, loose trousers and cream sneakers. iAstro is a little boy android with human face, spiky black hair, cyan temple and cyan heart, white tunic, purple shorts and white/purple boots. Preserve faces strictly. Keep Hugo usually on left and iAstro on right where both appear. Images supplied are ONLY character/style/wardrobe reference, never copy their layouts or lettering. September clothes: Hugo beige overshirt white T-shirt baggy charcoal trousers, iAstro normal white/purple outfit with small satchel, NO Halloween decorations. A delivery adventure metaphor about choosing suitable tools. Panel 1 wide: Hugo proudly sits in a gigantic yellow tractor to carry one tiny envelope, iAstro astonished beside it. Panel 2: iAstro reveals a small purple bicycle and a mid-size cyan cargo tricycle next to the tractor. Panel 3 profile action: iAstro easily carries the envelope on the bicycle along the garden path. Panel 4: Hugo and iAstro load wooden boxes onto the cargo tricycle. Panel 5 overhead: they compare three drawn route maps with colored dots and three small stacks of coins, NO text or numbers. Panel 6 broad comic payoff: Hugo happily rides the tiny bicycle while the giant tractor is now a ridiculous garden flowerpot; iAstro waters flowers growing in its bucket.
